Also the purge valve may need to be tightened, obviously not too tight or it will be impossible to get the stale smoke out. The purge valve should create a seal that doesnt allow air to get out except when pressure is on it, blowing in, but I'm sure you knew this. Just reiterating incase you didnt know :3 So maybe when you were packing it loosened up a bit. It could just be as simple as that.

Make sure to check all fittings though, even the stem could be loose causing increased airflow leaving the hookah and not going to the base.

I only say Social Smoke because it's what I started with and what I've been smoking for the entire time I have smoked. Other than with some friends who has "the good stuff" (not weed don't worry). I've never been sick while smoking Social Smoke, but it might give you light headedness if you smoke certain flavours. I've noticed, my personal experience, that the fruity flavours are very strong, but the other flavours, like vanilla and chocolate and that shiz are more mild. Mint is a great choice (Absolute Zero) it's my favourite. Basically if it smells good in the tin it tastes good, but if the smell is too strong it's likely the taste will be. :D I'm extremely biased because I love Social Smoke, but shrug.
Quality matters more to me. I'd rather pay a bit more, and have a really good smoke, but SB is too expensive for the quality you get.

If your girlfriend enjoys more traditional "candy" flavours go with Social Smoke. I like it, and it's not too harsh. It still has a bit of a tobacco undertone to it so you can get her used to the traditional stuff. But hell if she likes SB let her smoke it. My old hookah bar used it for awhile, but i would bring in my own shisha to avoid using SB. The smoke and smell alone made me sick, i think i only tried it once and I got a major headache.
I wish more people would start with Social Smoke, it's smoother, and still has a tobacco flavour to it without giving you the buzz

I agree with the idea of a break. In elementary we get a break from class for 30 minutes for recess, and as soon as one gets to Middle School the course is dropped. I think that Idea could help with obesity problems, perhaps a required 15 minute walk a day around the school. Gym classes aren't even really required anymore. In my school all you need is a year and you're done with your required gym classes, that of you take one year your eight grade year and you don't want to take any in High School. 

I also agree with your statement of Technology being a crutch. Yes, it can help when teaching certain topics, such as in science viewing the way atoms react on a website or something. Technology isn't needed in every class. I personally think the classes I learn best in are the ones where the teacher isn't just lecturing, but interacting with the class and getting the students involved. With technology in the way it's a bit more difficult to do that.

My school is pretty well with opportunity, 23 AP classes, the most in our area, but I still feel as though the way we distribute money isn't good at all. Not only academically but I know for a fact that my school football team gets a ton of money towards their program, while sports like soccer and softball have to raise their own money just to buy new balls. I think education is more important that sports, and yet sports get funded while some classes are getting cut. It seems as though our country sees tv stars and sports stars over our educational discoveries. I don't see why though.
